newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Protea interests may be split - report.
newsitem.headline: Protea interests may be split - report.

text.p: Mutual & Federal Ltd and Commerical Union Ltd (CU) have emerged as finalists in the bid for Protea Assurance Co Ltd, but a leading South African union may still be in the running, Business Day newspaper said.

It was reported earlier this week that the Congress of South African Trade Unions (Cosatu) had put together a consortium with other black groups to bid for control of the insurance firm from Britain's Royal Sun Alliance.

Business Day said sources close to the negotiations said if a decision was taken to sell Protea's short-term and life operations separately, Mutual & Federal will acquire the short-term business and CU the life operations.
But it said Cosatu's investment trust Kopano Ke Matla could be a strong contender if Royal Sun Alliance decided to sell its 80 percent stake in Protea to a single buyer.
The union's bid price is understood to be 100 rand a share, placing a 630 million rand price tag on the deal, the paper said.
